correctness.rationale: Uniform polynomial-over-exponential error establishes index-jump equals digit length for every sufficiently late step, even with unbounded lengths. Exact concatenation trapping forces correction in [-1,0] along an infinite walk, so the tail lies on constant good residues. The finite directed-cycle equivalence holds in both directions and a length-P self-loop exists at each good residue; rational integrality follows from the integer sequence. The standalone verifier checked seven families and 385 exact step pairs.

value.rationale: The arithmetic structure of subordinate roots of unity gives a natural large family of recurrences left undecided by independence-based results. The theorem gives a complete necessary-and-sufficient existence criterion and the precise minimal allowable digit length for every parameter choice in that family. Its exact cycle bottleneck distinguishes existence from sharp length optimization, with a nontrivial period-four threshold of two digits.
